notes.title: Update Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Here is the list of changes I made. 

Footsteps sound lowered
No more motion blur
Post-processing values can be changed in the options menu
Sensibility can be changed in the options menu
FOV can be changed in the options menu
Invert Control can be changed in the options menu
Menu translation
The main character's speed during sprint has been increased.
A few other small issues.
